stances.claim: The PET 15-0 dismissal -- written by Leonen, dismissing all three causes (CoC nullity, revision/recount where Leni's lead actually grew, and Mindanao terrorism-annulment for failure to allege protestee instigation) -- is legally beyond reversal; Bongbong's MR will be politically motivated.

Despite his miserable legal defeat, Bongbong remains a viable, even strong, contender for 2022 -- Pulse Asia (Feb 22-Mar 3) places him at 13% for president (not VP), second only to Sara at 27% -- and the survey was conducted AFTER the dismissal was publicly known.

VP Leni, in contrast, 'apparently failed to take advantage of the political worth of her sweeping legal victory,' coming in only 6th -- a quiet but pointed observation that legal victory and political traction are decoupled.

The Pulse Asia field misses several formidable candidates who deserve testing: Frank Drilon (experienced, scandal-free), Mark Villar (Build-Build-Build, family machine), Gwen Garcia (Cebu, regional powerhouse), and Win Gatchalian (undefeated, NPC).

notable_anecdotes: Justice Leonen's PET ponencia (15-0) -- CJ's reading of the decision as 'ably written,' with the dispositive detail that the recount in the three pilot provinces (Camarines Sur, Iloilo, Negros Oriental) actually GREW Leni's lead from 263,473 to 278,566 votes.

Bongbong's 13% Pulse Asia rating (Feb 22-Mar 3, 2021) -- conducted AFTER public knowledge of the dismissal and for the PRESIDENT, not VP -- used as the political-survival evidence overshadowing the legal defeat.
Leni's 6th-place 7% -- paired with the quiet diagnosis that she 'apparently failed to take advantage of the political worth of her sweeping legal victory.'
The 'Kay SARA, WIN tayo' slogan -- CJ offering a campaign tagline as a quasi-coded endorsement vehicle for a Sara-Win Gatchalian pairing.
Tony Carpio's 1Sambayan role -- explicit non-candidacy, instead 'searching for a worthy candidate with a reasonable chance of winning' -- affirming Carpio's principled positioning.

one_paragraph_summary: The Supreme Court sitting as the Presidential Electoral Tribunal dismissed, 15-0, Bongbong Marcos's election protest against VP Leni Robredo 'for lack of merit' in a Feb 16, 2021 decision (released only the week before this column) ably written by Justice Marvic M.V.F. Leonen, with Romulo Macalintal leading Leni's defense and George Garcia leading Bongbong's team. The three causes were dismissed in turn: the first (alleging non-authentic Certificates of Canvass) thrown out at the Pre-Trial Conference of Aug 29, 2017; the second (revision and recount of 36,465 clustered precincts) failing because the recount in the three pilot provinces (Camarines Sur, Iloilo, Negros Oriental) actually grew Leni's lead from 263,473 to 278,566; and the third (annulment of results in Maguindanao, Lanao del Sur, and Basilan for terrorism, intimidation, and pre-shaded ballots in 2,756 precincts) junked because protestant 'utterly failed to allege that protestee instigated' the irregularities. Despite this legal defeat, Bongbong remains a viable, even strong, contender in 2022: Pulse Asia's Feb 22-Mar 3 face-to-face survey -- conducted AFTER public knowledge of the dismissal and for PRESIDENT not VP -- places him at 13%, second only to Sara Duterte (27%) and marginally ahead of Grace Poe, Isko Moreno, and Manny Pacquiao. Leni at 7% places only 6th, having 'apparently failed to take advantage of the political worth of her sweeping legal victory.' CJ predicts Bongbong will file an MR -- not because a 15-0 decision can be reversed but to strengthen his political stock. Five months from COC filing, CJ notes the Pulse Asia field misses Frank Drilon (brilliant, diligent, scandal-free, the most experienced public servant around), Mark Villar (DPWH secretary, Manny-and-Cynthia heir, Build-Build-Build credentials), Gwen Garcia (Cebu and 'One Cebu' regional bloc), and Win Gatchalian (undefeated; 'Kay SARA, WIN tayo'). Tony Carpio leads 1Sambayan's candidate search, not as candidate himself. CJ closes with a six-tandem speculative matrix for ongoing Pulse Asia/SWS testing -- administration, opposition, regional, populist, surprise, and competent-celebrity pairings.
